pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + an ender pearl. Starts waiting without an anchor.

With full stamina and an empty main-inventory slot, right-click it with an empty hand to pin it and receive a Slime Teleporter. Linking spends all its stamina. Primary and shared owners may link it. The teleporter keeps the companion identity rather than a fixed coordinate.

Right-click in the air with the teleporter to reach a safe spot beside the living pinned companion across dimensions. The destination needs full stamina and spends it all on success. Teleportation consumes no pearls and deals no damage. Unsafe, missing, or unauthorized destinations retain stamina.

A pinned Ender Slime keeps one destination chunk ticking, including across restarts. The default limit is eight pinned companions per primary owner. Follow releases the anchor; recovery and collapse release its chunk. A restored pinned companion anchors at its new release position.

Rest restores 2% of maximum stamina each second, so a full recharge takes about 50 seconds at any maximum. Sharing and recovery keep the primary owner. Restoring a stored pinned companion needs a free anchor slot; at the limit, its item or Broken Slime Block stays intact.
